entities.summary: The murder of Magdalena Stoffels occurred in Windhoek, Namibia on July 27, 2010. The rape and murder of the 17-year-old schoolgirl caused demonstrations and a debate on Namibia's stance on the death penalty. The perpetrator was never found.
